responsibility: This file implements GCC’s generic machine-description reader infrastructure, shared by host generators and, in limited form, the compiler itself. It manages file and include traversal, location tracking, string and pointer-to-location association, define_constants and enum parsing, joined C-condition bookkeeping, diagnostics, include dependency callbacks, and top-level .md file reading loops, providing the foundational parser services on which read-rtl and many gen* tools depend.
same_name_distinction: Implementation of the generic .md reader: it defines md_reader behavior for file/include traversal, location bookkeeping, condition joining, diagnostics, and top-level machine-description reading loops, with generator-specific command-line reading support. Unlike gcc/read-md.h, which declares reader classes and associated data types, this .cc file performs the actual parsing and file-processing work.
